findings.text: blocking: 253 sources carry only a terminal reason and 58 carry no stored reason, so the required per-source run-log account of what consumed their attempts is absent; the 73 batch exceptions cannot be assigned to sources and the 149 cap cases remain symptoms rather than diagnosed causes.
